name: nexus_oauth_exchange
description:
Complete the OAuth2 flow: exchange the auth code for tokens. Requires a pending login from nexus_oauth_login.

Exchanges via PKCE code_verifier (+ client_secret when configured), saves
tokens to the token file, and validates the identity with the resulting
Bearer token. Tokens auto-refresh; any 4xx refresh response is treated as
revocation per the official guide.

Returns:
    JSON account summary from nexus_validate_key, or an error string.

code.description: The 'code' query parameter from the OAuth redirect after nexus_oauth_login.
code.title: Code

state.description: Optional 'state' value from the redirect URL; verified against the pending login when provided.
state.title: State
